personal.name: Ashutosh Yadav
personal.bio: AI/ML Engineer with hands-on experience building end-to-end machine learning systems, from data scraping and feature extraction to model implementation and hardware integration. Proficient in PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangGraph, and full-stack development with the MERN stack.

projects.title: Agent Evaluation & Benchmarking Framework
projects.description: Evaluation framework that benchmarks ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and LangGraph agents on custom and GAIA-style tasks. An automated harness measures success rate, token efficiency, error recovery, and latency across 100+ cases, with reflection loops and a comparison of LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen.

projects.title: Customer Support / Sales Multi-Agent System
projects.description: Multi-agent system built with LangGraph and CrewAI: a triage agent, a RAG knowledge agent, and specialist agents for billing, technical support, and sales. Includes sentiment analysis and human handoff, served through a FastAPI backend.

projects.title: Word2Vec from Scratch
projects.description: Skip-Gram and CBOW implementations of Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space, written in Python and PyTorch. Dense embeddings capture semantic relationships and are visualized with Plotly.

projects.title: Vibe Outfits Matcher
projects.description: Outfit recommender that scrapes products from H&M, Amazon, and Nordstrom with Scrape.do and Scrapy, stores them in MongoDB, and matches looks with embedding-based semantic search.

projects.title: SURF Feature Matching
projects.description: SURF (Speeded-Up Robust Features) implemented with OpenCV and NumPy to detect and match keypoints for object recognition and image stitching.

projects.title: RAG Chatbot for Summary and Chat
projects.description: Retrieval-augmented chatbot that summarizes and answers questions over uploaded documents. Combines a FAISS dense index with Hugging Face transformers via LangChain.

projects.title: Multimodal Telegram RAG Bot
projects.description: Multimodal RAG bot on Telegram that answers questions from a document knowledge base with source attribution and describes images with the Salesforce BLIP vision model. ChromaDB retrieval runs on all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings with Mistral or GPT-3.5 generation, plus per-user conversation memory and TTL response caching.

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis of Web Blogs
projects.description: Pipeline that scrapes 150+ blog posts with BeautifulSoup and classifies sentiment with NLTK. Includes a from-scratch classifier compared against standard NLTK functions.

projects.title: Facial Emotion Recognition
projects.description: Sequential CNN trained with Keras on FER2013 to classify 7 facial emotions at 65% accuracy. Image preprocessing and data augmentation were used to reduce overfitting.

projects.title: Full-Stack Web Applications
projects.description: Suite of web projects including an Amazon price tracker in Python and a real-time Tic-Tac-Toe game built with the MERN stack and Socket.IO.

experience.company: ESniff Devices (Incubated at SIIC, IIT Kanpur)
experience.description: End-to-end development of an AI-powered E-Nose for identifying food adulterants. Optimized sensor hardware for gas pattern analysis and built a pattern recognition model at 85% test accuracy. Architected the data pipeline from raw sensor collection through preprocessing to classification, served predictions with FastAPI, prototyped a Streamlit interface, and automated acquisition and inference with LangGraph agents.

Processed 100,000+ audio files with the VGGish model for feature extraction ahead of a sound classification task. Built a Python scraping pipeline with BeautifulSoup and Requests that collected and cleaned 1.5 million images to expand the dataset.

Developed and maintained a MERN e-commerce application. Built REST APIs with Node.js and Express for authentication, inventory, and orders, and a streaming FastAPI chat component (Python, React, MongoDB) that can be embedded on any site.
